title: How to organize the outdoor seating zone | Patio or Deck
description:
Seats people can drop into without checking them first, with the cushions kept dry.

This is the Outdoor Seating Zone in the Patio or Deck. About 45-75 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
Four chairs you can sit in without testing, set close enough to talk across, every cushion in the deck box, and no cover crumpled on the ground behind a planter.

THE SIX PASSES
Sort: Sit in every chair. The one that wobbles, the one with the cracked resin arm, and the cushion you would not of
Straighten: Chairs face each other close enough to talk without raising your voice, and no chair sits in the swing of the
Shine: Hose the frames and scrub the webbing where grit packs into the joints, then stand each chair on its side so w
Safety: Resin and plastic chairs go brittle from years of sun long before they look it.
Standardize: One cushion per seat and none spare, so a gap in the box tells you a cushion is still out on a chair.
Sustain: When you carry the last glass inside for the night, the cushions come in with you in the same trip.

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
One cushion per seat, all of them in the deck box overnight, and no chair blocking the door swing.
